claim_ceiling: Dense multilingual-e5 embeddings with center projection provide three validated complementary views at characterized minimal scales: (1) citation heritage recovery superior to TF-IDF at 21-24yr/137k-158k (AUC 0.77-0.85), (2) section cross-lingual alignment for facts/holdings at 1K sample (Sachverhalt 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150), (3) linear hybrid complement passing adversarial gates at 19yr+ but remaining below TF-IDF jurist preference baseline. Dense embeddings cannot serve as primary jurist-preference representation (true OOS ceiling ~0.53 vs. 0.7 target).
evidence_summary: 25 evidence references verified across scale characterization (3yr-24yr/19k-165k), three complementary modes (citation heritage AUC 0.767-0.770 at 24yr with 730 pairs, section cross-lingual Sachverhalt 0.282/Dispositiv 0.150/Erwaegungen 0.094 at 1K, linear hybrids JP 0.61-0.67 at 19-22yr), two-mode tradeoff reproduction, true OOS ceiling ~0.53, three audit repairs verified (comprehensive_validation JP anomaly fixed, citation_role_integration fractal collapse fixed with overclustering detection, overclustering gate implemented), persistent data blockers documented (bge_/bger_ mapping, 2024-2026 parquet, section extraction). All negative/null results honestly represented as first-class evidence.
